title: Global ERP Solutions Manager 2 - Supply Chain
jd_text: RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No CLEARANCE TYPE: None TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career. Northrop Grumman’s Corporate Sector's Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) is seeking a Global ERP Solutions Manager 2 - Supply Chain to support the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) organization's Global Supply Chain team. The selected candidate will lead a team of highly skilled Level 3 Enterprise Applications Analysts and Technical Experts, while being responsible for architecting new solutions and projects in support of our global SAP S/4HANA platform and related digital solutions. This leader will: Own end‑to‑end solution strategy and technical design for key SAP S/4 and Supply Chain capabilities. Manage Level 3 operations for critical ERP services, ensuring reliable, high‑quality production support. Serve as the primary point of contact between Enterprise Services and Sectors/Divisions/Business Units to translate business strategy and program requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technology solutions. Drive continuous improvement, analytics, and integration capabilities as part of Northrop Grumman’s Supply Chain and ERP digital transformation. A virtual work arrangement may be available; however, the selected candidate will be expected to be within driving distance to a Northrop Grumman office. Periodic travel (up to ~10%) may be required for key program, customer, and team engagements . Key Responsibilities: Solution Ownership & Architecture Lead the solution technical architecture and roadmap for SAP S/4 capabilities with a focus on Global Supply Chain and end‑to‑end business processes. Integrate the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) with SAP business processes to enable workflow, extensions, and analytics. Define and manage Supplier Collaboration scenarios (e.g., purchasing document and attachment exchange) between SAP S/4 and external suppliers/partners. Oversee integration patterns and API configurations involving SAP S/4, Ariba, and other enterprise platforms. Level 3 Technical Operations & Service Delivery Manage a global Level 3 ERP support team responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex issues across multiple SAP service lines. Ensure the overall technical quality, performance, stability, and security of solutions in production, meeting or exceeding business SLAs and customer expectations. Provide oversight to recurring and non‑recurring ERP support activities, including incident management, problem management, and defect remediation across multiple programs, Divisions, and Sectors. Establish and maintain sound technical processes, standards, and methods in accordance with company procedures, quality standards, and project protocols. AI / ML & Intelligent Automation Evaluate and recommend AI/ML tools, platforms, and frameworks appropriate for integration into the ERP — including predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and process optimization use cases. Support the design of data pipelines and infrastructure (data lakes, model serving layers) that enable AI/ML workloads within compliant government IT boundaries. Collaborate with organizational stakeholders to translate AI capability needs into actionable ERP/Supply Chain infrastructure requirements. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary liaison between CIDO and Sector/Division/Business Unit leadership for ERP and Supply Chain solutions. Collaborate with program leadership, homeroom managers, functional leaders, and end‑user groups to identify, prioritize, and deliver ERP capabilities that support program strategic and tactical objectives. Translate business strategy and domain roadmaps into executable technology plans, balancing near‑term needs with long‑term platform health and scalability. Partner with Supplier Management, Procurement, and Operations teams to continuously improve supplier collaboration, visibility, and performance through SAP capabilities. Delivery Leadership & Continuous Improvement Support the design, development, integration/test, and deployment of new ERP and digital capabilities, including coordination across internal teams and external partners. Manage project and support budgets/schedules for assigned programs and initiatives; monitor performance and proactively address risks and issues. Implement and champion Continuous Improvement practices to optimize ERP capabilities, streamline processes, and improve user experience, aligned to Northrop Grumman’s digital transformation objectives. Where applicable, leverage SAP ACTIVATE Methodology to manage and de-risk implementations. People Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically dispersed team of Level 3 Enterprise Applications Analysts. Set clear priorities and manage capacity, and staffing across the global ERP support team. Foster a culture of customer focus, technical excellence, accountability, and innovation. Promote knowledge sharing, cross‑training, and succession planning within the team. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Manufacturing, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline and 8 years relevant experience; OR Master’s degree with 6 years of relevant experience. Significant hands‑on experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA applications supporting core business processes (preferably in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations). 5+ years of experience in at least one of the following: Solution architecture or enterprise architecture for SAP S/4 and related platforms OR, Technical leadership of Level 3 ERP support teams in a complex, multi‑business‑unit environment. Demonstrated experience with: SAP configuration in Supply Chain / Procurement or related functional areas. At least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (design through go‑live and stabilization). Designing or supporting integrations between SAP and external systems (APIs, middleware, BTP, or Ariba). Proven project/program management experience, including planning, scheduling, budget/cost awareness, risk management, and status reporting. Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from technical teams to non‑technical business users and Executive Leadership; strong presentation skills. Experience successfully deploying business process capabilities into a Production environment and sustaining them through structured support processes. Customer‑focused, results‑oriented leader with demonstrated ability to drive cross‑functional teams to action in a matrixed organization. Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment and can quickly learn program and process contexts. Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Systems Engineering, Supply Chain/Manufacturing Management, Computer Science, or related STEM discipline. Deep experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Materials Management. Hands‑on experience with: SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for extensions and integrations. SAP Analytics Cloud configuration and solution delivery. Supplier Collaboration integrations between SAP S/4 and external vendors/portals. Ariba configuration, especially Sourcing and Supplier Lifecycle & Performance modules. Prior Enterprise Services or shared‑services environment experience; familiarity with global ERP operating models. Defense industry and/or aerospace & defense experience, with understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements. Demonstrated application of Continuous Improvement concepts, methods, and tools (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen) to IT/ERP processes. Experience leading Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban) with a strong understanding of Agile ceremonies and metrics. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to challenge the status quo and propose innovative, practical solutions to complex requirements. We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivate your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us! Primary Level Salary Range: $133,200.00 - $199,800.00 The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business. The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

title: Principle Program Manager, New Product Transition - E4
jd_text: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $116,000.00 - $159,500.00 Location: Austin,TX You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . This role will be onsite at our Austin, Texas location. (Not remote or hybrid.) Primary Responsibilities: Lead matrixed operational team of New Product Manufacturing Engineers, Material Project Managers, DFX Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, Supplier Engineering, Procurement, and Manufacturing Program Managers to manage program deliverables from Manufacturing Operations. Engage Pilot Manufacturing to ensure early learning builds meet target milestones. Resolve business process operational issues between the Business Unit, Pilot Operations, and Volume Production. Align with Cross Functional Product Management Team to develop plan and execute product commercialization strategy. Engage Engineering team to analyze design and identify product improvements for enhanced volume manufacturability. Manage risk exposure to the division through analysis of production maturity. Interface with Business Operations of the BU on execution of operational strategy. Initiate and lead Operations strategies to improve business processes. Drive Product Life Cycle Operations deliverables for Business Unit New Product Introduction programs. Prepare and present high level presentations on Program status and strategic overview to senior management. Assisting the top management in his/her reports, follow up with his directs for all the data and information required. Organizing meetings, preparing Agenda, MoM for meetings and following up on action items to closure. Planning and Defining Scope, Activity Planning/Sequencing and Resource Planning. Developing Schedules, Time, Cost Estimation, Budget, and Documentations Risk Analysis, Managing Risks and Issues, Monitoring and Reporting Progress regularly. Cross-project interdependency management to manage conflicting priorities and plan resources. Good understanding of the wider objectives of the program and defining the benefits that will realize the strategic objectives of the program. Mandatory Skills: Effective communication skills both written and verbal to communicate to diverse functional groups and stakeholders on the program/project status. Ability to work positively in a team environment with wide range of individuals involved in program management under pressure and efficiently manage priorities to meet tight deadlines. Strong leadership and management skills with ability to lead functional teams or projects with moderate resource requirements, risk, and/or complexity. Strong interpersonal skills with ability to communicate difficult concepts and negotiate with others to adopt a different point of views. Strong analytical, problem-solving and synthesizing skills finding innovative ways to resolve problems with ability to lead others to solve complex problems. Ability to interpret internal/external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Demonstrates depth and/or breadth of expertise in own specialized discipline or field. Proficient & skilled in Microsoft PowerPoint to effectively communicate to program cross functional teams. Good knowledge and handling of project and program management methodology and techniques. Sound knowledge and understanding of Mfg. Operations in Product Life Cycle and Engineering Change Management. Proficient in Microsoft Project to develop project plans and schedules. Expertise in data gathering, analysis, and creative in reporting using Charts and analytical reporting with Microsoft Excel. Good knowledge of budgeting and resource allocation procedures for Financial planning and tracking Eligibility Criteria: Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in any Engineering discipline (preferably in Mech/Electrical) with M.B.A Experience: Minimum 6-8 years’ experience in project management, program management, data analysis. Exposure to Semiconductor Industry is a PLUS Desirable Skills: Working knowledge of SAP Exposure with developing Excel Macros PMP / Scrum Certification Working with relational databases MS SQL Server Exposure to data analytics tools such as Minitab. Additional Information Time Type: Full time Employee Type: Assignee / Regular Travel: Yes, 10% of the Time Relocation Eligible: Yes The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable. For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. title: Imaging Business Analyst (On-site)
jd_text: Who We Are At Newrez, we bring big thinkers and caring doers together to make home happen. We’re a team built on heart and hustle, united by a commitment to show up for our customers, our communities, and each other. We believe that when our people thrive, homeowners thrive - and that’s why we invest in your growth, wellbeing, and ability to make an impact. Every day, we work to exceed the expectations of our residential mortgage borrowers and business partners through superior service, simple processes, and clear communication. We do this by empowering our employees, encouraging innovative solutions and recognizing great performance. Primary Function The Imaging Business Analyst will provide critical support for Imaging and document retention to process and monitor compliance to performance standards. This position protects performance standards for document ingestion and export processes. Failure to perform at standards would cause major negative impact downstream for all servicing departments and outside partners. Principal Duties Provide analytical support for imaging and document retention software/systems (i.e., Carbon Copy, OnBase and H2O). Work successfully with business, PMO and IT to document and coordinate new process implementation. Develop ad hoc reporting on image reconciliation. Work with the reporting team to enhance standardized reporting for business on performance, SLAs, and quality results. Provide services for onboarding of images for client transfers including post document load analysis and missing document investigation. Provide services for uploading ad-hoc images for Servicing as needed. Provide services for exporting of images for Sales/Releases Monitor and trouble shoot all vendor document interfaces with document repository systems. Provide document upload/export support to all Document Repository customers. Perform BAT testing for enhancements to processes owned. Create SQL queries. Other tasks as assigned by management and business need. Performs related duties as assigned by management. Education and Experience Requirements High school diploma or equivalent, required. Bachelor's degree, preferred. 2-4 years of Business Analyst experience. Experience in business analytics and process documentation. Knowledge, Skill, and Ability Requirements Knowledge of Mortgage industry business processes. Advanced Excel skills. Intermediate SQL skills. Familiarity with working in a data warehouse environment. Strong verbal communication skills; strong writing and composition abilities. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain effective relationships across the organization. High learning agility with the ability to learn and integrate business variables and learn new systems and platforms. Strong analytical skills & problem-solving abilities; solid decision-making abilities coupled with sound judgment. Effective at managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. High degree of professional maturity, integrity, ability to maintain confidential data and information. High degree of business acumen; strong technical aptitude. Strong client orientation. Strong Microsoft Office skills to include Excel, pivot tables, sorting, and conditional formatting. SQL skills to create simple to intermediate queries. Additional Information: While this description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the position’s requirements, it in no way implies/states that these are the only job responsibilities. Management reserves the right to modify, add or remove duties and request other duties, as necessary. All employees are required to have smart phones that meet Company security standards with the ability to install apps such as Microsoft Authenticator. Employment will be contingent on this requirement. Why Newrez We’re a great place to work because we invest in what matters: your career, your community, your wellbeing, and your future. Our total rewards package is designed to support your whole self. Company Benefits : We offer benefits, programs, and perks that support you in every aspect of your life. Medical, dental, and vision insurance Health Savings Account with employer contribution 401(k) Retirement plan with employer match Paid Maternity Leave/Parental Bonding Leave/Caregiver Leave Adoption Assistance Tuition & Certification reimbursement Employee Mortgage Loan Program The Newrez Employee Emergency and Disaster Fund is a program to support our team members experiencing hardships Newrez NOW: Through Newrez NOW, our Corporate Social Responsibility program, you’ll have opportunities to give back, lead, and make a difference. 1 company-paid Volunteer Time Off day (with over 40,000 volunteer hours contributed since our inception) Matching Gifts Program - dollar-for-dollar up to $1,000 Access to grants, nonprofit resources, and volunteer opportunities More than $6,000,000 donated since 2020 1 in 5 employees participates in at least one Employee Resource Group (ERG) Equal Employment Opportunity We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer- and celebrate our employees' differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status. Different makes us better. CA Privacy Policy CA Notice at Collection

title: Senior Maximo Business Analyst
jd_text: Job Type: Regular Plains is an industry-leading transportation and midstream provider specializing in transportation, storage, processing and marketing solutions for crude oil. We own an extensive network of pipeline transportation, terminalling, storage and gathering assets in key oil producing basins and transportation corridors and at major market hubs in the United States and Canada. The company is headquartered in Houston, Texas. We’re on the lookout for passionate self‑starters who thrive in fast‑moving, collaborative, and innovative environments. Role Purpose/Summary: The Maximo Business System Owner is the principle point of stakeholder coordination and end-user system management for the PAA instance of the Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) system. They play a critical collaboration, planning, and work execution role between the Operations, Commercial (Trucking), and IS teams to ensure that operational business requirements are properly captured, related system functions are enabled, and system configurations changes made by IS are adopted effectively by the respective business teams. Their portfolio of oversight and execution of work within Maximo spans three core areas of End-user Management, Data Management, and System Configuration Change Management. This is an office-based role but requires a detailed understanding of field operations, maintenance, and safety work practices, as well as detailed technical knowledge of Maximo and related technology elements (e.g., system data structures, system administration / security practices, system configuration testing, etc.). The selected candidate will be eligible for company benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), and Free Parking. Responsibilities: Engage with the respective stakeholder teams from Commercial (Trucking), Operations, Engineering, and HSE at least monthly to provide updates on supported initiatives, forthcoming system changes, or new system capabilities that may be of interest. Support business process improvement efforts that can leverage system capabilities to enhance work execution, including documenting process changes and business scoping or functional requirements. Work with stakeholders and the technology function to define a multi-year roadmap for system capabilities development aligned to emerging business requirements. Capture, prioritize, and manage stakeholder system initiatives and enhancements through to completion. Oversee larger project efforts that require new or significantly enhanced system capabilities or integration with other systems. Act as the primary point of contact with IS for the PAA Maximo instance and work to debottleneck application management support to ensure timely system improvements (i.e., find ways to accelerate backlog resolution). Plan and oversee testing of all system changes for the respective instances prior to implementation. Collaborate with other team members to ensure training / reference guides necessary to adopt system changes are developed and provided to stakeholders. Provide direct business support to resolve end user issues, progress business initiatives, and accelerate system enhancements. Analyze / evaluate end-user system issues that arise and identify mitigations or potential solutions. Assist with functional requirements gathering and system configuration design. Exercise critical decision making and discretion in performing tasks; redirect solution implementation if desired results were not originally met. Communicate effectively with departmental team members and management to ensure alignment of expectations, work progress, and outcomes achieved. Demonstrate safe work practices following Plains’ safety policies and procedures. Responsible for informing senior personnel of hazard identification and near misses. Responsible for completing other related duties that may be assigned based on operational requirements and priorities. Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required: Requires a 4-year college degree in STEM or a related discipline. A minimum of five years of experience in a technical analysis, maintenance / reliability, or engineering role. Ability to speak, read, and write English and the ability to perform basic math. Detailed knowledge across a broad range of field operations, maintenance, and safety work practices. Experience managing end users, data, and system configurations for EAM and related software platforms. Ability to work in a team-based work environment, with strong communication and interpersonal skills. Maintains a thorough knowledge of Plains’ O&M Manual, specifications, and forms used to document inspection and maintenance activities. Must have a detailed knowledge of the Maximo EAM platform and related technologies. Must have comprehensive computer skills and experience using Microsoft Office suite with strong emphasis on Excel and/or other spreadsheet applications. Must be familiar with PHMSA and OSHA regulations as well as Plains’ operating procedures. Must have an outstanding safety record. Ability to successfully complete company training as assigned. Legally authorized to work in the job posting country. Qualifications: Valid drivers’ license with a clean abstract in the job posting state / province. Cleared criminal history (background) and satisfactory reference checks. Compliance with the Company’s drug and alcohol policy including pre-employment screening. Problem Solving: Identifies problems and leads other team members to implement innovative solutions. Ability to identify other stakeholders to assist in complex problem solving. Accountability: Takes ownership of SME tasks for business group, modifying responsibilities as required. Leverages internal and external resources within own work and/or in specific projects. Cleared criminal history (background) and satisfactory reference checks Compliance with the Company’s drug and alcohol policy including pre-employment D&A testing. This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. for the duration of their employment. #Plains At Plains, our employees are our most valuable asset. Hard work is rewarded with competitive compensation and a top-tier benefits program designed to keep our employees safe, healthy and happy. We work hard to deliver the best results to our stakeholders, and we also respect our employees' need for personal and family time, which is reflected in our benefits program . We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, without regard to age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Applicants with disabilities can request accessible formats, communication supports, or other accessibility assistance by contacting WebCareers@Plains.com . Salary details estimated by job boards such as Indeed, Glassdoor, and LinkedIn do not represent Plains’ compensation structure. We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. By submitting your resume, you consent to the collection, use and necessary disclosure of the personal information provided during the application and selection process. Learn more .

title: EPIC Revenue Cycle Senior Reporting Business Analyst
jd_text: Job Category: Administrative & Clerical Work Shift/Schedule: 8 Hr Morning - Afternoon Northeast Georgia Health System is rooted in a foundation of improving the health of our communities. About the Role: Job Summary The Reporting Business Analyst Sr. is a senior member of the Data and Analytics Team and is responsible for assessing customer analytic needs and providing guidance on best possible course of action to address. The Report Business Analyst Sr. will be familiar with end-users workflows and well-versed in the complete catalog of NGHS' Analytics tools in order to be able to align the customers business requirement with the analytic solutions most appropriate for meaningful, actionable intelligence. This role will have primary responsibilities for real-time or near real-time applications reports that are generated from the Epic production database using Reporting Workbench, develop custom metrics & RW SQL reports as well as operational dashboards using Radar. This role will have extensive interaction with operational team members and leadership, and will be tasked with analysis of business data and analytics requirements, and the transformation of those requirements into analytics solutions. The Reporting Business Analysts will also partner with the NGHS Technical Training team to develop and Implement training and documentation solutions that enable business stakeholders to get the most out of self-service analytics tools, such as Slicer Dicer and Qlik Sense. Reporting Business Analyst Sr. will also be instrumental in establishing and enforcing best practices, mentoring junior analyst team members in both the technical and functional areas. This Reporting Business Analyst Sr. will also work closely with the manager in prioritizing the intake of requests, enhancements and projects. This person should also be able to keep up with Epic updates and plan for retiring legacy assets and converting them to new tools & technologies. Strong project management skills; ability to formulate action plans and timelines and to execute those plans; ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Strong analytical skills to interpret, adapt, known methods, system procedures or operating concepts to new situations. Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. Performs a variety of complex tasks. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. Demonstrated ability to achieve results through team efforts, willingness to challenge established practices draw relevant conclusions. Leads and coaches team members to achieve goals, objectives and personal growth. Minimum Job Qualifications Licensure or other certifications: Epic Cogito fundamentals, Cogito Tools Administration, Clarity Data Model, Caboodle Data Model and one of the two (clinical/access data model) certifications/accreditation required. (Additional applicable software experience will be considered ). Must be obtained within 12 months of date of hire. Educational Requirements: Bachelors Degree Required in Computer Science or related field. In lieu of Bachelors Degree related experience in the field, ten (10) years progressively responsible, professional job specific work experience and an equivalent combination of education and training that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities, combined with demonstrated professional growth and achievement. Minimum Experience: A minimum of six (6) years experience with various BI and other analytic reporting software applications with at least 2 of these years in EPIC Reporting Workbench reports and radar dashboards. Prior experience providing production level support and/or development in business intelligence (BI) environments. Excellent SQL skills - with the ability to write complex queries that perform well against high volume datasets. Strong knowledge and experience in data warehouse concepts, enterprise data management practices, participation in strategy discussions is needed. Other: Preferred Job Qualifications Preferred Licensure or other certifications: Preferred Educational Requirements: Preferred Experience: Other: Job Specific and Unique Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills; demonstrated ability to work with management and customers; proven ability to work independently or as a team member; strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills; ability to translate complex information into simpler terms and concepts Service-oriented; must be committed to superb customer service Excellent communication (written, verbal and presentation) and people-facing skills, Proven ability to maintain positive peer, customer relationships, interacting positively and productively with teams across organizational lines. Demonstrates skills in critical thinking, and consensus and relationship building Understanding of the full reporting delivery life cycle, from requirements definition to report development and testing required as well as understanding of data management best practices and proper use of data management technologies Comfortable presenting to and meeting with senior management, physicians and all levels of staff Experience in creating and maintaining reports that summarize data to be used by management Must be able to function in dynamic environment subject to changes in schedules and priorities, working on multiple projects/ issues concurrently. Responsibilities may require evening and weekend work in response to needs of the systems supported Understands healthcare, hospital and ambulatory terminology, business practices, and industry trends and ideas for data analysis, including regulatory regulations such as HIPAA, DNV and MIPS Experience in understanding end user needs and gathering requirements, determining data specifications, designing solutions, or modifying existing work to meet new or changing needs Knowledge of clinical documentation and orders databases, data conversion models, workflows, master files, category lists, synonyms and preference lists Experience in understanding end user workflows and determining the most appropriate analytics solutions that supports the operational workflows that will provide end users with the data that is needed in the manner that is needed in order to solve the end user's business problems Ability to perform job duties independently with minimal supervision and assist other team members in leading complex projects from inception to completion Leads team in intake management and assists team members as needed to be sure priorities are aligned and followed up on efficiently Essential Tasks and Responsibilities Maintains a service oriented approach with customers, providing follow up and responding to issues/ concerns in a timely manner. Answer staff and client questions in person, via email and via phone. Provide after-hours on-call support on a scheduled basis. Responsible for ensuring service level agreement adherence. Creates standard or custom reports, dashboards, views, etc. summarizing clinical, financial, or operational data for review by executives, managers, physicians and other stakeholders using the Epic Cogito BI tools (Reporting Workbench, Radar, or Slicer Dicer) or Qlik Sense. Utilizes the report request and development process, including the development of an understanding of a report request, assessment of the appropriate tool to be used to provide the data, creation of a report specification in partnership with the operational stakeholder and application analyst, development of the report and validation of the report by the operational stakeholder to ensure quality, timeliness and accountability. Serves as the primary point of contact for end users in specific operational areas for reporting needs. Partners with operational stakeholders to understand current reporting, analytics and data needs/requests and help determine the best approach to meeting those needs. Partners with operational stakeholders to develop data requirements/specifications so that the appropriate report or dashboard can be developed to meet the need. Partners with operational stakeholders to validate reports, dashboards and analytics to ensure that the data that is being produced is accurate and represents what the end user needs. Prepares and maintains key documents and technical specifications for new and existing solutions. In partnership with the Technical Training team, educates and supports end users in specific operational areas in their use of self-service reporting tools like Epic's Slicer Dicer program, Epic's Universes and Cubes, and Qlik Sense., Partners with the Epic application teams to ensure that roles/security templates or end users in Epic have the appropriate access to reports and dashboards. Works closely with end-users to identify and explain data and reporting discrepancies. Monitors intake queue. Efficiently troubleshoot, resolve, report and close active issues. Mentor junior members of the team on all the technical and functional areas Document standards and best practices and enforce through code reviews of reports to ensure they are being followed. Plan and execute for retirement of legacy tools (Crystal reports) and conversion to evolving technologies (RW SQL, Qlik etc.) Physical Demands Weight Lifted: Up to 20 lbs, Occasionally 0-30% of time Weight Carried: Up to 20 lbs, Occasionally 0-30% of time Vision: Moderate, Frequently 31-65% of time Kneeling/Stooping/Bending: Occasionally 0-30% Standing/Walking: Occasionally 0-30% Pushing/Pulling: Occasionally 0-30% Intensity of Work: Frequently 31-65% Job Requires: Reading, Writing, Reasoning, Talking, Keyboarding, Driving Working at NGHS means being part of something special: a team invested in you as a person, an employee, and in helping you reach your goals. title: Business Capability Architect - Enterprise Focused
jd_text: RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time Description At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. In rapidly changing global security environments, Northrop Grumman brings informed insights and secure technological solutions to enable strategic objectives. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career. Northrop Grumman is seeking a Staff Computer Systems Architect to serve as the Business Capability Architect - Enterprise Focused . The selected candidate will own the current-state and target-state architecture for a combined enterprise-focused capability portfolio spanning Human Capital Management, Supply Chain Management, Financial Management, Portfolio and Project Management, Business Acquisition, and Enterprise Management across the enterprise. This role sits within Strategy and Architecture, part of the Governance & Strategy organization in the Chief Information & Digital Office, and serves as a capability-aligned architecture role spanning organizational boundaries, solution portfolios, and enabling functions rather than a single project or system. The Enterprise Focused Business Capability Architect is responsible for guiding capability evolution across workforce, supply chain, finance, portfolio and project governance, acquisition, and enterprise-management processes, along with the related data, platforms, controls, and integration patterns required to connect those domains into one coherent capability roadmap rather than disconnected local improvements. This position will be available as a virtual telecommuter, however, the incumbent most be within 90 miles of a major Northrop Grumman location for ad hoc onsite meetings. The successful candidate will: own the current-state and target-state architecture for the enterprise-focused capability portfolio spanning Human Capital Management, Supply Chain Management, Financial Management, Portfolio and Project Management, Business Acquisition, and Enterprise Management across organizational and solution boundaries; define capability roadmaps spanning platforms, workflows, data exchanges, operating processes, reporting needs, controls, and modernization initiatives that support enterprise-focused outcomes; partner with business, application, data, technology, security, infrastructure, and delivery stakeholders to improve coherence in enterprise-focused decisions; and help translate enterprise architecture direction into practical capability priorities, sequencing, and transformation guidance for integrated enterprise-focused business outcomes. Key Responsibilities: Serve as the Business Capability Architect for the combined enterprise-focused capability portfolio spanning Human Capital Management, Supply Chain Management, Financial Management, Portfolio and Project Management, Business Acquisition, and Enterprise Management. Define and maintain the current-state and target-state architecture for the supported enterprise-focused capabilities across the enterprise. Develop capability roadmaps that span multiple systems, services, products, and initiatives supporting workforce, supply chain, finance, portfolio governance, acquisition, and enterprise-management functions. Translate enterprise standards, architecture methods, and target-state direction into capability-specific architecture guidance for the supported enterprise-focused portfolio. Identify dependencies, sequencing needs, reuse opportunities, and trade-offs across ERP-adjacent, planning, reporting, governance, control, and shared-enterprise management landscapes. Guide solution and delivery teams so initiatives supporting Human Capital Management, Supply Chain Management, Financial Management, Portfolio and Project Management, Business Acquisition, and Enterprise Management advance one coherent target state rather than optimize locally. Partner with stakeholders across Governance & Strategy, Enterprise Applications, IT Infrastructure & Operations, CISO & Global Cybersecurity, Insights & Intelligence, finance, supply chain, HR, acquisition, and PMO-related functions where capability alignment is required. Support enterprise decision-making by clarifying capability outcomes, process implications, data dependencies, control requirements, reporting needs, and operating-model impacts tied to enterprise-focused modernization. Escalate enterprise-level standards conflicts, investment trade-offs, or cross-capability issues to the Business Architecture Lead and Chief Enterprise Architect as appropriate. Contribute patterns, lessons learned, and roadmap updates back into the broader architecture practice. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field and 12+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with 10+ years, or PhD with 8+ years. Candidates must have the ability to obtain, and maintain, a U.S. Government Secret level security clearance as a condition of continued employment. Strong experience in architecture for business capabilities, enterprise business systems, ERP-centered or shared-services environments, planning and control processes, or complex cross-functional portfolios. Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries and connect target-state design to delivery planning and operational outcomes. Experience creating roadmaps, patterns, and architecture guidance across multiple solutions, systems, or services. Strong stakeholder-management and influence skills across business and technology organizations. Ability to operate as both strategist and practical architectural guide for a capability area spanning multiple related business capabilities. Experience in regulated, security-conscious, or compliance-driven environments. Knowledge of TOGAF ADM or other Architecture Frameworks Strong knowledge of the Aerospace and Defense business domain. Preferred Qualifications: Prior experience in enterprise, business, domain, or capability architecture roles. Experience supporting human capital, supply chain, finance, ERP-enabled governance, portfolio and project management, acquisition, or enterprise-management processes. Experience in defense, aerospace, federal, or similarly regulated environments. Experience mentoring delivery architects while maintaining common architecture standards. Ability to connect business capability planning with operational execution, modernization investments, and enterprise performance outcomes. Experience working with matrixed stakeholders across strategy, finance, HR, supply chain, acquisition, PMO, cybersecurity, applications, infrastructure, and analytics functions. We offer flexible work arrangements, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. At Northrop Grumman, we are on the cutting edge of innovation. Our diverse portfolio of programs means there are endless paths to cultivating your career. We also offer exceptional benefits/healthcare, a 9/80 work schedule option, and a great 401k matching program. Come join us! Primary Level Salary Range: $161,000.00 - $241,400.00 The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business. The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. title: Procurement Associate- Data Center Gray Space
jd_text: NorthMark Strategies is a leading investment firm, combining capital, innovation, and engineering to drive long-term value. From operating complex businesses to backing breakthrough technologies, our mission is to build enduring businesses. Our team combines intelligent risk-taking, operational excellence, exceptional talent, and world-class computing capacity to create shareholder value. Our company offers a dynamic environment where individuals have the freedom to lead companies toward bold achievements by embracing innovation, leveraging technology, and fostering differentiated business strategies. Our values are Integrity, Ability, and Energy, and the company aims to hire individuals who possess those qualities. At NorthMark Strategies, we believe the future isn’t something to hope for, it’s something to build. We don’t just invest, we create. Bringing together strategic insight and technical horsepower to deliver outcomes that endure. The Position We are seeking a Procurement Associate for Mechanical Equipment who will be responsible for buying the mechanical, electrical, and plumbing equipment for our OFCI data center construction program. The Procurement Associate – Mechanical Equipment executes the purchasing that keeps that model running: issuing and administering purchase orders for major mechanical equipment, expediting long-lead deliveries, and coordinating daily with our third-party EPC partner so equipment arrives on site in line with the construction schedule. This is a hands-on execution role working under Grey Space category leads. It suits a buyer with 4–6 years of direct procurement experience who knows mechanical equipment — chillers, cooling towers, air handling, pumps — and can run a disciplined PO book in a fast-moving construction environment. Responsibilities: Execute and administer purchase orders for owner-furnished mechanical equipment, including chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/fan wall units, pumps, piping and valve packages, VFDs, and related systems. Support category leads through sourcing events: prepare RFQ documentation, build bid tabulations, and manage supplier communications through award. Expedite long-lead equipment; track production milestones, ship dates, and delivery status against construction schedule milestones, and escalate slippage risk early. Coordinate OFCI delivery logistics with the third-party EPC and site teams, covering freight arrangements, delivery sequencing, offloading and laydown requirements, and receiving documentation. Manage the full PO lifecycle in the ERP: change orders, milestone payment tracking, invoice discrepancy resolution, and closeout. Track vendor submittals, drawing approvals, and factory witness test / factory acceptance test (FAT) schedules; keep documentation moving between vendors, engineering, and the EPC. Support over/short/damage (OS&D) and warranty claims with vendors and freight carriers through resolution. Maintain supplier records, pricing history, and lead-time intelligence for the mechanical category; contribute to supplier scorecards and status reporting. Requirements: 4–6 years of direct procurement experience with hands-on buying responsibility (PO execution and administration) for capital equipment, engineered systems, or construction materials. Demonstrated buying experience in the mechanical discipline: chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, pumps, HVAC packages, or comparable engineered mechanical equipment. Working knowledge of the full procure-to-pay cycle and ERP-based purchasing. Experience managing long-lead equipment, including expediting and delivery risk management. Working command of commercial terms: Incoterms, freight terms, payment milestones, and warranties. Strong Excel and tracking discipline; able to maintain accurate delivery and status data across a large book of open POs. Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, engineering, construction management, or business — or equivalent experience. Preferred Qualifications Experience in data center, mission-critical, semiconductor, or other heavy industrial construction environments. Familiarity with OFCI/CFCI delivery models and working alongside EPC or GC partners. Exposure to factory witness testing and factory acceptance test coordination. Ability to read mechanical equipment schedules, specifications, and submittals. Microsoft Dynamics 365 or comparable ERP experience. APICS/ASCM (CPIM, CSCP) or ISM (CPSM) certification. Therefore, the above job description is not comprehensive or exhaustive. The Company reserves the right to adjust, add to or eliminate any aspect of the above description. The Company also retains the right to require all employees to undertake additional or different job responsibilities when necessary to meet business needs. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. title: Maintenance Planning Manager - Project Farma
jd_text: When joining PerkinElmer, you select an experienced and trusted leader in scientific solutions, with the support of a global service network and distribution centers, providing the right solution, at the right time, to meet critical customer needs. With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services. Job Title Maintenance Planning Manager - Project Farma Location(s) Customer Site - TX Job Description This is a full-time salaried position with Project Farma, a PerkinElmer company. The successful candidate will reside in the Houston, TX market and be willing to travel domestically, to meet client project requests. The Maintenance Planning Manager is responsible for leading the development and implementation of maintenance strategies for capital projects within life sciences manufacturing environments. This role supports the development of maintenance packages and reliability programs required to establish effective asset management plans during facility design, construction, and commissioning. In this client-facing consulting role, the Maintenance Planning Manager collaborates with engineering teams, project leadership, and client stakeholders to ensure maintenance programs are integrated into project delivery and aligned with operational readiness requirements. Responsibilities include maintenance planning, reliability analysis, spare parts strategy, and CMMS implementation to support long-term facility operations. The role also contributes to Project Farma’s project delivery objectives by ensuring maintenance planning activities support successful project execution while aligning with the company’s Patient Focused and People First culture. Key Responsibilities Maintenance Strategy & Planning Develop maintenance packages and asset maintenance strategies for capital projects in accordance with client procedures, engineering standards, and project planning documentation. Lead development of maintenance plans supporting operational readiness and lifecycle asset management. Perform Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analyses to define preventive maintenance requirements. Identify and define spare parts requirements to support facility startup and long-term operations. Maintenance Package Development (MPD) Lead development and execution of Maintenance Package Development (MPD) activities for capital projects. Collect and manage project data required to support maintenance planning and documentation development. Develop maintenance planning documentation and procedures for facility assets. Support MPD planning, estimating, and project schedule development activities. CMMS Implementation & Data Management Ensure maintenance data is properly structured and loaded into Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS). Support CMMS configuration and asset data preparation to enable maintenance program execution. Collaborate with project teams to ensure maintenance documentation supports asset lifecycle management. Project Delivery & Client Collaboration Partner with engineering, commissioning, and operations teams to integrate maintenance planning into project execution. Provide project status updates, planning inputs, and budget tracking for maintenance planning activities. Ensure maintenance planning deliverables are completed in alignment with project timelines and quality expectations. Support coordination with Global Facilities Delivery (GFD) or equivalent engineering organizations responsible for capital project execution. Leadership & Operational Excellence Provide technical leadership and guidance related to maintenance planning and reliability engineering practices. Support development of best practices and standardized maintenance planning approaches across projects. Maintain awareness of industry standards, reliability practices, and maintenance technologies relevant to life sciences manufacturing environments. Experience Required Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering , Life Sciences, Reliability Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience). Experience supporting capital projects within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences manufacturing environments. Experience developing maintenance strategies, reliability programs, or asset management plans. Experience performing Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analyses. Experience implementing or supporting CMMS systems such as Maximo, GMARS, or similar platforms. Blue Mountain and SAP PM Other Preferred Ability to travel as needed to support project delivery and client engagements. Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across engineering, maintenance, and operations teams. Experience working within GMP-regulated manufacturing environments preferred. Proven ability to support project delivery while aligning maintenance strategies with operational readiness goals. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We will not sponsor applicants for current or future work visas for this position. This position may require significant travel to support project and business needs. We cannot employ anyone with an invalid driver's license. The annual compensation range for this full-time position is $(110,000 - $160,000). T he final base pay offered to the successful candidate will be determined by factors including internal equity, work location, as well as individual qualifications, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. PerkinElmer is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. PerkinElmer is committed to a culturally diverse workforce.
